title: Artifact policy layer as a compatibility facade (no behaviour change)
commit_subject: S1-A: add the artifact policy layer as a compatibility façade

files.note: zero modifications to existing code is the strongest available evidence of 'no behaviour change'

what_it_adds.ArtifactPolicy: pattern, role, invalidation_mode, final_input, submission_member, ownership_rule (None => policy-only), blocker
what_it_adds.ArtifactRole: closed 12-value vocabulary (assigned to registered paths in S1-B)
what_it_adds.compatibility_policy(): derives a policy from one legacy ownership rule, copying every delivery field verbatim
what_it_adds.artifact_policy(): same matching semantics as artifact_ownership (case-insensitive, normalized, globstar, first match)
what_it_adds.artifact_policy_owner_stage(): Stage routing via the policy layer
what_it_adds.shadowed_ownership_rules(): detects a policy-only entry stealing a path from an ownership rule (CI invariant 3)
what_it_adds.NATIVE_POLICY: empty in S1-A; S1-B populates it with the 21 observed paths

why_it_is_a_no_op: current_artifact_ownership.py untouched, so artifact_ownership() is byte-for-byte unchanged
NATIVE_POLICY is empty, so every policy today is ownership-backed
artifact_policy() returns None exactly when artifact_ownership() does

ci_invariants.1_ownership_rule_consistency: PASS - strengthened to IDENTITY (is), not equality: the policy carries the very object the legacy API returns, so the two registries cannot drift for one path
ci_invariants.2_field_by_field_equality: PASS - compatibility_policy copies pattern, semantic_domain and both delivery flags verbatim from the rule
ci_invariants.3_no_policy_only_shadowing: PASS - vacuous while NATIVE_POLICY is empty, so a second test feeds the detector a deliberately shadowing policy to prove it is not a no-op

real_data_verification.source: A cumcm_2026_a_fable_pro_20260910, read-only, its real dirty_causes history
real_data_verification.conclusion: reproduces the S1 baseline exactly (192 paths / 21 gap paths) and proves the policy layer introduces no divergence

policy_only_mechanism.purpose: a policy-only entry (ownership_rule=None) describes and classifies a path without claiming a Stage owner; such entries do NOT appear in artifact_ownership()
policy_only_mechanism.why_it_matters: this is how S1-B registers the 21 fallback paths without inventing Stage owners for diagnostic/exploratory files, and without a second ownership registry
policy_only_mechanism.non_blocking_semantics: is_non_blocking = EXPLICIT_ONLY + final_input False + submission_member False + no named blocker (the S1.3 closure); declares_blocker separates that positive declaration from a missing consumer

identity_separation_preserved.Q14: artifact_policy is NOT part of classifier_contract_sha256(); a test asserts that hash still equals c451a9d0be64fabd185c7561b67093956e663db6e845915cd320fea1cbabc515 after the import

test_baseline.delta: +385 (the new module is heavily parametrized over a 118-path corpus)
